parts.text: The rainstorm flooded the wetlands and washed Phineas Frog 0.2 miles away from his home in the swamp.
To return home, he will need to hop and swim his way back.

If he hops on land at a speed of 0.02 miles per minute, and swims through water at a speed of 0.01 miles per minute, how long will it take Phineas, in minutes, to return home if half of the distance is on land and the other half is in water?

parts.text: During a rainstorm, the wetlands were flooded and Phineas Frog was washed 200 yards away from his home in the swamp.

If he hops on land at a speed of 20 yards per minute, and swims through water at a speed of 10 yards per minute, how long will it take Phineas, in minutes, to return home if half of the distance is on land and the other half is in water?
Along the way, he spots a delicious fly 50 yards off his path.
If he decides to catch the fly, it would take him an extra 5 minutes, but he decides to stay focused on his journey home.
